kind: Local prospective protocol before any new real-model generation; synthetic CPU unit tests already run; not public registration
cohorts: A and independent reference B, each128 independent Gaussian starts; same starts reused at two resolutions
fresh_source_policy: NumPy SeedSequence([seed,10]), independent128 samples; identical across times and resolutions
integration: Physical-time Euler, exact fixed knots; raw fp32 unclipped states; not the historical epsilon-warped sampler or published quality reproduction
boundary: Same m*endpoint+(1-m)*noise for both chord interventions; replace only boundary state, keep exact same suffix grid/model; true-path replay is software positive control
other_times: Fixed contrasts .5 and .7**(1/3), no selection of best time
primary_metric: Raw-pixel Gaussian RBF empirical V-MMD squared, k=exp(-||x-y||^2/(2*d)), d3072; subtract independent A-versus-B true-path empirical score as descriptive finite-cohort excess, not unbiased population correction
sensitivity: Bandwidth sqrt(d)*{.5,2}; U-MMD squared not truncated; empirical Hungarian W2 per sqrt(d); paired RMS, centered pixel moment; no Inception/FID/quality claims
analysis: 18 seed-resolution-time cells, 36 chord intervention cells; descriptive three generation seeds, no p values, no model or bandwidth tuning, no new training replication
numerical_check: Nested64/128 call grids; report coarse-fine RMS, all signs and margins; no claim of exact ODE convergence
skipped_policy: Any missing cell/nonfinite/call mismatch/replay error>1e-6 fails full study
output: raw snapshots archived on server with hashes; summaries and source versioned; full raw copy to Mac after GitHub sync
